title: ailanthus altissima var. sutchuenensis
intro: Ailanthus altissima var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as the Chinese tree of heaven, is a plant species in the family Simaroubaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ailanthus altissima var. sutchuenensis include its ability to act as a hepatoprotective agent, supporting liver health and function, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
